# PubMed

> > A comprehensive biomedical literature database providing access to millions of research articles, clinical studies, and scientific publications from MEDLINE and life sciences journals.

PubMed is maintained by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) at the U.S. National Library of Medicine. It serves as the primary resource for researchers, clinicians, and healthcare professionals to search peer-reviewed biomedical and life sciences literature.

## Key Topics

- Hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs)
- HIF-1α and HIF-2α transcription factors
- Oxygen homeostasis and hypoxia response
- DNA barcoding and species identification
- Cytochrome c oxidase I (COI)
- Glucose metabolism and metabolic regulation
- Pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) and PDK1
- Sleep physiology and sleep stages
- Emotional intelligence assessment
- Pulmonary hypertension
- Mitochondrial DNA analysis
- Transcriptional regulation
- Taxonomic classification
- Combat casualty care

## Molecular Biology and Physiology

- [Hypoxia-inducible factors in physiology and medicine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22304911/): Research article on HIFs as master regulators of oxygen homeostasis
- [Physiology, Sleep Stages](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30252388/): StatPearls reference on REM/NREM sleep stages and physiological patterns

## Genomics and Taxonomy

- [Biological identifications through DNA barcodes](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12614582/): Study on DNA barcoding using cytochrome c oxidase I for species ID

## Psychology and Behavioral Sciences

- [Human abilities: emotional intelligence](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17937602/): Review article on emotional intelligence theory and measurement approaches

## Clinical Medicine and Emergency Care

- [Tactical combat casualty care in special operations](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8772308/): Military medicine study on ATLS protocols for combat casualty care
